name: qq-history-recovery
description: Recover a person's own QQ chat history across all three Tencent stores: the mobile classic QQ database (plain SQLite, repeating-XOR field cipher), the desktop Msg3.0.db and message-manager .bak exports (the MSG0 modified-SQLite format), plus a Frida-based import monitor that instruments a desktop-to-phone migration. Documents the full reverse-engineering journey and every environment trick. Chat history is private data and never enters the repo; only synthetic fixtures ship.
